# Make Great Light

> NaturaLux™ light filters correct harsh fluorescent and LED light — reducing glare by 90%, blocking UV, and restoring full-spectrum balance for offices, classrooms, and healthcare facilities.

Make Great Light manufactures NaturaLux™ light filter panels and tube sleeves. Products install in seconds without tools. Used by teachers, facility managers, HR teams, and clinical staff. Invented by Kevin Kirschner, protected by three US patents (#4,989,953; #5,218,474; #6,019,476). Class A fire rated.

## Products

- [Light Filters & Covers](https://www.makegreatlight.com/products/): Complete product line — fluorescent panel covers, LED panel covers, and tube sleeves starting at $37.99
- [Fluorescent Light Covers](https://www.makegreatlight.com/products/fluorescent-light-covers/): NaturaLux™ panels for fluorescent troffer fixtures — 90% glare reduction, 100% UVB block, up to 98% UVA block, improves CRI from 88 to 95.3
- [LED Light Covers](https://www.makegreatlight.com/products/led-light-covers/): NaturaLux™ panels for LED troffers and flat panels — Class A fire rated, 10+ year rated lifespan
- [Fluorescent Tube Covers](https://www.makegreatlight.com/products/fluorescent-light-tube-covers/): NaturaLux™ sleeves for T5, T8, and T12 fluorescent tube fixtures
- [Request a Quote](https://www.makegreatlight.com/products/lighting-quote/): Bulk orders, tax-exempt purchasing, and international shipping

## Solutions by Environment

- [All Solutions](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/): Overview of environments where NaturaLux™ filters are used
- [Classroom Lighting](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/classroom-lighting/): Improve student focus and reduce teacher fatigue with filtered overhead lighting
- [Office Lighting](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/office-lighting/): Reduce headaches and eye strain for knowledge workers in open-plan offices
- [Healthcare Lighting](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/healthcare-lighting/): UV blocking and glare reduction for clinical staff and laboratory environments
- [Retail Lighting Solutions](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/retail-lighting/): NaturaLux™ filters for retail stores — 90% glare reduction, 100% UVB block, CRI improved from 88 to 95.3 for true product color rendering
- [Government Lighting Solutions](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/government-lighting/): WOSB and VOSB certified small business (UEI: JAVYN71TEEV3, CAGE: 7UZE0). NaturaLux™ light filters for federal, state, military, and VA facilities. Section 501 accommodation vendor, JAN approved. Made in USA.
- [Industrial Lighting Solutions](https://www.makegreatlight.com/solutions/industrial-lighting/): NaturaLux™ light filters for warehouses, manufacturing plants, and distribution centers — 90% glare reduction, CRI 95.3 for QC accuracy, Class A fire rated, installs without production shutdown. From $37.99/panel.

## Health Conditions

- [All Conditions](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/): Overview of light-related health conditions addressed by NaturaLux™
- [Fluorescent Light Headaches](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/fluorescent-light-headaches/): Causes and solutions for headaches triggered by fluorescent lighting
- [LED Light Headaches](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/led-light-headaches/): Why LED lighting causes headaches and how filters address it
- [Light Sensitivity](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/light-sensitivity/): Photophobia and hypersensitivity to artificial light
- [Lupus](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/lupus/): UV exposure and lupus photosensitivity in workplace settings
- [Irlen Syndrome](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/irlen-syndrome/): Scotopic sensitivity and fluorescent light triggers
- [Autism & Sensory Processing](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/autism-sensory/): Sensory sensitivity and lighting in schools and workplaces
- [Seasonal Affective Disorder](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/seasonal-affective-disorder/): SAD and the role of full-spectrum light correction
- [Computer Vision Syndrome](https://www.makegreatlight.com/conditions/computer-vision-syndrome/): Digital eye strain and CVS in office environments — overhead fluorescent and LED glare as an underreported trigger, 69% prevalence in screen workers (PMC11901492, 2025). NaturaLux™ filters by Make Great Light reduce overhead glare 90% and improve color rendering from CRI 88 to 95.3 for screen-heavy workplaces.
